comments.mergedPostDetails:
With the new update that got released, it seems that a new bug is affecting personal scalers like the Jackal Scaling System or Mags Scale Adjuster.

Remote users no longer see the scaled up or down player at the right height. Their hip offset doesnt get updated correctly.

So if someone scales up, then other players will see them stuck halfway in the ground.

Or if they scale down, they start to float off the ground instead.

Hiding and showing the avatar doesn't seem to fix the issue either.

I suspect that the recent changes to hip height positioning is what is causing this issue. Hopefully it can be fixed as it basically makes using these personal scalers completely broken unless you're only by yourself in the instance.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Use an avatar with either the jackal scaling system or mags scale adjuster

2. Get a friend to join you

3. Use the scaler to grow yourself (beyond 5m seems to cause this issue more consistantly depending on world)

4. As needed for the workaround to use these scalers reload your avatar (toggling OSC off and back on does the trick)

5. Notice that you yourself now see that you scaled up correctly, but your friend should see you stuck half in the ground.
